name: Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture
summary: At the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen, a stockpile of potent poison lies locked away. The mixture bears the name of Zanzil, a jungle troll witch doctor, and draws the Shattered Hand's attention.

sections.title: A Toxic Enterprise
sections.body: North of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens, the Venture Company holds a tower outpost. At its summit, Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix keeps a cache of altered mixture bearing the name of the troll witch doctor Zanzil in his private strongbox. A poison has weakened everyone in the tower, leaving its goblin inhabitants vulnerable to a bold intruder.

sections.title: Recovery for the Shattered Hand
sections.body: The Shattered Hand, a secretive rogue guild beneath Orgrimmar, has taken notice of dangerous alchemical materials so close to Durotar. Master trainer Shenthul sends operatives to storm the tower, kill Gallywix, and break open his lockbox. The guild seeks both to neutralize the threat and to study the mixture for its own intelligence work. Recovering the volatile cache demands strong infiltration skills. The contaminated container's toxins can leave whoever handles it exposed and debilitated.

faq.answer: Zanzil's Altered Mixture is a potent poison named for the troll witch doctor Zanzil. A cache of it lies locked in the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen, where a poison has weakened everyone inside.
The cache is in Gallywix's Lockbox at the top of the Venture Company tower, north of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the Shattered Hand want the mixture?
faq.answer: Shenthul and the Shattered Hand seek to neutralize the Venture Company operation right on the Horde's doorstep and recover the compound for their own intelligence studies.

faq.q: How do you open the chest containing the cache?
faq.answer: The chest has delicate tumbler locks that call for advanced lockpicking skill, and the contaminated container can expose its handler to debilitating toxins.

angles.text: For Horde rogues, retrieving the mixture is an essential rite of passage, proving mastery of lockpicking, pickpocketing, and poison handling in service to the Shattered Hand.
The Venture Company's poison-laden tower north of the Sludge Fen threatens the surroundings and security of both Durotar and the Barrens.
